lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized grid of circular high-luminance spots; approximately 4 to 5 vertical spots between primary carinae, forming roughly parallel vertical columns posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Spots are positioned at the intersection of faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal structural ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges traverse the mid-to-upper flank, exhibiting a pronounced shadow on the inferior side and high-luminance highlighting on the superior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple remoras (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally near the pectoral fin; primary pectoral fin exhibits a high-density, stochastic distribution of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots.
